mapper.select: SELECT id, base_id, group_id, base_group_id, name, description, icon, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM `bitable_tables` WHERE base_id = #{baseId} AND deleted_at = 0 ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `bitable_tables` WHERE base_id = #{baseId} AND deleted_at = 0
SELECT MAX(t.sort_order) FROM `bitable_tables` t INNER JOIN `bitable_bases` b ON b.id = t.base_id AND b.deleted_at = 0 WHERE t.deleted_at = 0 AND COALESCE(t.base_group_id, b.group_id) <=> #{groupId}
